themes.description: Users report frequent crashes, long loading times for charts, and UI glitches that prevent smooth trading operations.
themes.business_impact: Slow performance and crashes directly hinder trade execution, causing users to miss market opportunities, generate a surge of support tickets, and increasing churn risk as customers migrate to faster, more reliable platforms.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app’s performance issues stem from inefficient network handling, suboptimal rendering of chart data, and legacy UI components that are not optimized for modern mobile hardware, leading to excessive memory usage and CPU load.
themes.action_plan:
• Profile network requests and reduce latency
• Refactor chart rendering pipeline to use hardware acceleration
• Redesign UI components for responsiveness and error handling
• Implement robust timeout and retry logic
• Add automated performance regression tests for critical trading flows
• Deploy incremental improvements through staged releases

themes.description: Users complain about unresponsive support, delayed responses, lack of clear communication, and hidden maintenance fees and penalty interest that push accounts into negative balances.
themes.business_impact: Loss of customer trust leading to high churn, negative brand sentiment, potential regulatory scrutiny over undisclosed fees, and lost revenue from dormant accounts still being charged.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Support processes lack defined SLAs and escalation paths; billing transparency is insufficient, causing hidden fee perception; limited communication channels result in customer frustration.
themes.action_plan:
• Expand and train support staffing
• Implement strict ticket SLA with automated reminders
• Add multiple contact channels (email, WhatsApp, in‑app chat)
• Automate and transparently display maintenance fee schedule
• Review and publicize fee policy
• Conduct quarterly support quality audits
